Transfer: Notre Dame (2024, shared backfield with Jeremiyah Love) → Texas A&M (2025). Breakout at age 20 at Notre Dame despite competing for carries with Love — a top-tier RB1 prospect. One-hit-wonder risk remains; YAC consistency gap is the primary model concern.

Transfer: New Mexico State 2024 (lower competition, weak OL) → Arkansas 2025. Arkansas 2025 OL ranked 110th/133 FBS in sacks allowed; mid-season emergency line adjustments. Production season (62.8 score) was behind one of the worst OLs in FBS. Elite combine profile (4.33 / 39.0 vert / 128 broad, RAS 66) — athleticism is genuine. Red flags: MTF/touch 0.165 (9th-worst Day 2 RB since 2014); YAC+catch 2nd-best season 47.6 yd/game. Scouting consensus: thrives in gap/power with defined lanes; struggles in space; 'often taken down by first tackler' (PFF). OL context is mitigating but doesn't fully explain away the contact quality gap. Gap/power scheme + functional OL is prerequisite for upside.
